ENGLISH MARCH — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ENGLISH MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. Only an action
   C. A person, place, thing, or idea
   D. Only a describing word

2. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.2 Speaking: Etiquette, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.2 Speaking: Etiquette.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.2 Speaking: Etiquette.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.2 Speaking: Etiquette.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.2 Speaking: Etiquette.

3. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. quickly
   B. run
   C. blue
   D. happiness

   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.4.1 Sentence skills: Sentence fluency ● avoiding ambiguity in pronoun .

5. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. Where is the Library
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

6. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Extensive Listening ● listening for enjoyment and g, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Extensive Listening ● listening for enjoyment and g.

7. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Only one word repeated
   B. One main idea with supporting sentences
   C. Many unrelated topics with no link
   D. No full stops
